fields.value: The Dallas Independent School District issued RFP #JA-207652 for Student and Staff Computing Devices. Proposals must include a detailed M/WBE compliance plan, any required Mentor‑Protégé Agreement, product literature, and an insurance/bond coverage form to be submitted within ten days of award. The solicitation’s closing date is July 9, 2024, with a pre‑proposal meeting scheduled for June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST (via TEAMS). Submissions may be made electronically through the iSupplier portal or as a sealed hard‑copy envelope delivered to Procurement Services (phone 972‑925‑3700, email ProcurementCS@dallasisd.org). The contract term is three years with two one‑year renewal options, not to exceed five years total.
